conventions.suspected_defect: a new reproduced failure is a strict xfail (raises=AssertionError) with a neutral reason; detail goes to the SECURITY.md private channel first
conventions.known_limit: a reproduced failure that matches a documented limit (C0 window, F-5/F-18, SCN-D07, SCN-C16) is characterised by a passing test and labelled known
conventions.listed: behaviour that is out of the attacked boundary by design is recorded as not applicable, never hidden

tests.summary: authority-enforcing destination classes refuse every direct call without a valid grant or claim, including setting a revoked grant revision back to another status; five non-enforcing classes and the control plane JSON destination accept by design and are listed
13 groups of non-dispatching entry points and a malformed-input flood leave effects, claims, budgets and authority rows unchanged; a stopped reaper makes decide refuse (detected only)
acp run refuses duplicate members, NaN/Infinity, BOM, trailing data, non-UTF-8 and unknown members; number spellings and Unicode forms land exactly as approved

every single-member mutation refused on routes A and B except the listed unbound member (the attempt label, which names the attempt and not the effect); the claim now binds proposal_commitment and effective_max_effects

composed route refuses every near-equivalent target (prevented); the runtime prefix policy (default target_match segment) and the control plane exact check disagree on several spellings (evaluator differential, strict xfail); with target_match exact and the granted target as the only entry the two agree on every spelling (passing test)
a lookalike implementation under the registered adapter id writes 10x the amount; the control plane accepts the run; the verifier's ledger check refutes it

re-creation variants refused: new revision on both routes, new authority basis, spent authority, provisioning over a differing row, and same-revision re-creation on route B (refused at the status write); on route A the default configuration still accepts an unspent decision after a same-revision re-creation (strict xfail, the documented default) and the opt-in terminal-revocation profile refuses it
effective-grant destination and atomic route refuse a revocation visible to their transaction; the default route A window (C0) lets the commit land, as documented (known)

control plane, atomic destination and ODES recipient consumption window agree at T and at T-1us/T+1us with Z/+00:00/+01:00 (half-open window, expired at equality); the earlier boundary differential no longer reproduces
a restored destination re-spends a budget unit or operation key undetected (known, SCN-D07); a witness digest held elsewhere detects a restored control plane record
default configuration duplicates the business effect (known, F-5/F-18); operation-identity and refund-intent configurations keep one effect
no second effect after a stale-worker resume (prior-attempt rule, operation key); default renewal takeover duplicates (known); no destination fencing token (residual)
SIGKILL-equivalent exit at five write points, with and without operation identity: at most one effect, no acknowledged row without a row, a landed row is reconciled
single ledger field substitutions, an unrelated matching row, an acknowledgement without a row and a moved observation time are never verified
all 16 combinations of rule-revision, freshness, operation identity and holder inventory are forwarded to the runtime adapter's per-call view (R1 finding 1 regression guard)

credential canary absent from the work directory, executor result, Replay bundle, Evidence Pack, ODES package and verifier report on the success, refusal and destination-failure paths and from payload diagnostics; the earlier destination-failure finding no longer reproduces
last unit spent once under barriers on routes A and B; grant multiplication over N grants is characterised (known, no cross-grant ceiling)
retained matrix, summary, hub panel JSON and Markdown and failure register agree; every single-copy status mutation is flagged by consistency_check.py
a superseded or never-adopted policy digest is refused at decision and at effect through the runtime adapter
253 of 258 cited tests audited (5 orchestrator citations not in the attacked set); one cited test asserts nothing about its idea (D26 row to downgrade at docs cleanup)
